name: Creepless
tagline: The scope referee for agencies and freelancers
description: Creepless is AI-powered scope-creep software for agencies and freelancers. Each client gets a no-login request link. An AI referee checks every request against the client's agreed scope and marks it included, extra, or needs review. Included work goes to your team; extra work becomes a quote the client approves before work starts. Free plan covers 2 clients; paid plans from $15/mo.
